days.title: Zuheros and Geological Wonders
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Santa Rita
stops.detail: As the main tourist attractions, the park has a visitor center (Santa Rita), an ecomuseum (Cueva de los Murciélagos), several viewpoints, and nine trails.

stops.name: Cueva de los Murciélagos
stops.detail: Cueva de los Murciélagos. Near Zuheros.

stops.name: Cañón del río Bailón
stops.detail: Cañón del río Bailón: from Carcabuey to Zuheros via Navazuelo, Fuentefría and the Bailón riverbed.

stops.name: Vía Verde de la Subbética
stops.detail: Vía Verde de la Subbética: connects Puente Genil with the provincial border of Jaén, passing through Lucena, Cabra, Doña Mencía and Zuheros, about 57 km, an old Linares-Puente Genil railway line.
